result: A swan is exactly right for us. Our oldest and proudest trophy is the Silver Swan, so it'll feel like it belongs on that wall, and I like the long curve of the neck. My only worry is that the body is a bit lopsided and pointed at the left end, so at a glance it reads more like a crescent or a banana than a swan on the water. I'd want it to look unmistakably like a swan from across the room.
